games.name: Cosmo in Tarot: Tarot Study Simulator
EA SPORTS™ MVP Bundle (College Football 27 Deluxe Edition & Madden NFL 27 Deluxe Edition) Pre-order Content
Arcade Survivors
games.summary: It's 1996. Lightning strikes the strip-mall arcade and monsters pour from every screen. Grab a Super Soaker, load your VHS bombs, and survive until dawn in this neon-soaked bullet heaven where your weapons fight for you. One more quarter. One more run.

games.name: Casino of Time
games.summary: Casino of Time is a roguelike game where you gamble with your time. Your time ticks down and you must try to earn enough time to survive as long as possible in the casino. A variety of permanent upgrades is provided every 2 minutes to tilt the odds in your favour!

games.name: Depths of Providence
games.summary: Depths of Providence is a turn-based roguelike JRPG through 100 procedurally generated floors. Your party enters at level 1 with empty pockets. Fight down through instant-death depths and escape with rare loot before you lose it all. Bank blue-chest relics forever and climb the daily leaderboard.

games.name: Dune War
games.summary: Explore the desert. Mine rare crystals. Build your base. Survive the machine assault. Dune War features a single-player intro campaign and an endless high-score mode where every run is a fight over who control the dunes.

games.name: Flak Duty
games.summary: Flak Duty is a short, linear sci-fi visual novel about an operator whose routine shift inside an automated flak machine goes wrong. Read the story in an illustrated filmstrip format, with page navigation and light or dark reading modes.

games.name: Iridio
games.summary:
Seized by criminals, the island designated for your research needs your help.

Join Yatziri and the Wazhari tribe to liberate their hostages, explore hidden secrets, craft essential items and weapons, and strategically use fire and water in challenging puzzles and life-or-death battles for survival.

games.name: Miners, Moos & Miracles
games.summary: Miners, Moos & Miracles is built from the ground up as an incremental idle game, wrapped in a nostalgic retro-styled shell. Manage a small homestead (gold, barley, milk, eggs, and more), then hop between a handful of themed mini-games tied together by the same world.

games.name: Mogami-tei R
games.summary: A Japanese-style horror visual novel set in 1980s Japan. Five years after a mysterious disappearance, Yukari Kanzaki and Akane Kiryu enter the abandoned Mogami Mansion. Explore its hidden secrets, uncover its dark past, and face multiple endings shaped by your choices.

games.name: No More Room In Hell 2
games.summary:
In the sequel to the 2011 award-winning Source mod, you and your fellow survivors must make your way through a diseased world that has seen the dead rise to feast on the living. Cooperation and teamwork are vital if the human race is to survive this living hell.

The world endured the Kulon pandemic that induced comas or death in its victims for over a year. Governments scrambled to quarantine infected cities or outright collapsed as millions became infected. Scientists had a promising vaccine ready for distribution until the infected began dying, only to wake with an insatiable hunger for human flesh. Chaos and death leave you and the remaining survivors in the most desperate fights of your lives as you run, stab, smash, and blast your way to safety.

games.name: Retro Robot Rescue
games.summary: Guide M.R.1 through a corrupted robot factory, battle hostile machines, collect biomass, and upgrade at the Forge in this retro-inspired top-down arcade shooter.

games.name: Rule or Fall
games.summary: Govern wisely in this narrative choice-based game set in the heart of the Middle Ages. Your choices will have a real impact on your entire adventure, the world and its characters! Skillfully manage your image and your throne to survive and prosper. Or fall.

games.name: Sacred 2 Remaster
games.summary:
Ancaria stands on the brink. T-Energy, the mysterious power source that once brought prosperity, now fuels corruption, conflict, and chaos. In the midst of war and betrayal, six heroes rise - each with their own fate, abilities, and path through a living, breathing open world.

In this remaster of the beloved action RPG Sacred 2: Fallen Angel, players return to a massive fantasy realm filled with hundreds of quests, dangerous dungeons, and unique combat arts to master. Battle monstrous creatures, uncover ancient secrets, and shape your character through loot, leveling, and deep customization.

With refined combat mechanics, a modern UI, full controller support, and all expansions included, the remaster brings new life to a fan-favorite - whether you’re revisiting Ancaria or setting foot in it for the first time.

Forge your legend. The fate of Ancaria awaits.

games.name: Seina: a Tale Of Spirits Demo
Shanhai Exorcist: Yin-Yang Chronicles
games.summary: Build a dual-faced deck, balance Yin and Yang, and lead one of four exorcist schools through a replayable roguelike journey. Read enemy intents, flip cards to change their effects, shape powerful synergies, and seal demons in tactical turn-based battles.

games.name: Shelves and Sorcery: Tidy Up the Enchanted Shop
Starforge Reborn
games.summary: Starforge Reborn is a gritty top-down 2D space roguelite. Salvage Crystals, Starforge Coins, & Starforge Holo Coins to upgrade your mobile Forge, unlock 8 ships & 20 support drones, fight 15 enemy types and 15 brutal bosses—single-player only, with Campaign permanence and run-only Survival builds.

games.name: The Carcass
games.summary: A typing-driven Lovecraftian colony sim. You wake inside the corpse of a dead god, adrift in space. Carve a roguelike colony from procedurally generated anatomy — negotiate with rival alien factions, evolve occult mutations, find your ending. The carcass remembers.

games.name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
games.summary: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion™ Remastered modernizes the 2006 Game of the Year with all new stunning visuals and refined gameplay. Explore the vast landscape of Cyrodiil like never before and stop the forces of Oblivion from overtaking the land in one of the greatest RPGs ever from the award-winning Bethesda Game Studios. Journey through the rich world of Tamriel and battle across the planes of Oblivion where handcrafted details have been meticulously recreated to ensure each moment of exploration is awe-inspiring. From the noble warrior to the sinister assassin, wizened sorcerer, or scrappy blacksmith, forge your path and play the way you want. Step inside a universe bursting with captivating stories and encounter an unforgettable cast of characters. Master swordcraft and wield powerful magic as you fight to save Tamriel from the Daedric invasion. Experience everything Oblivion has to offer with previously released story expansions Shivering Isles, Knights of the Nine, and additional downloadable content included in The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered.

games.name: WIND CAT SOLITAIRE
games.summary: Welcome to a peaceful, nostalgic game of Solitaire. But beware: there's a fan blowing wind, and a cat is here too! Splendidly "parry" unreasonable cat punches, gather blown-away cards, and force your way to victory. A new sensation of action-interrupted Solitaire!

games.name: Word Farm (Grove)
games.summary: A 2D pixel game where you can memorize words while farming, making word memorization no longer boring.

games.name: Words Of Power (Tsuperion Games)
games.summary: Words of Power is a fill-in-the-blank style rogue like deck builder. Travel deep into the dungeon below and fight using the power of words! Construct sentences of devastating power and manipulate the sentences of your foes to turn the tides of battle.

games.name: Yo Skater
games.summary: A 2D precision platformer/endless skateboarding game that lets you ollie, flip, grind and yoyo your way through an infinite range of terrain, traps and obstacles!

games.name: ZOMBIE CAM BODY CAM SHOOTER
games.summary:
Step into the chaos of ZOMBIE CAM: Bodycam Shooter, where every heartbeat counts and the undead are closing in. Feel the tension as you navigate dark corridors, dimly lit streets, and abandoned buildings, every step bringing danger closer.
Arm yourself with a mix of weapons and gear, from rifles and pistols to flashlights and grenades, and adapt on the fly to survive relentless waves of zombies. Each map offers a new challenge, each wave a test of courage—and every second matters.

games.name: 徘徊之碑 - Lingering Stele Demo
A Short & Simple Pixel Love Story
Agefield High: Rock the School
games.summary:
Relive your High School days in the town of Agefield. It’s the early 2000s, and graduation is on the horizon. REBEL with your friends, win over your dream girl and ROCK the school! 

A coming-of-age adventure about friendship, love, and rebellion inspired by the raunchy teen comedies of the era.

games.name: Akatori
games.summary:
Akatori is a metroidvania/slasher platformer with a charming pixel-art and a captivating story. You're going to follow the young girl Mako that starts a fascinating adventure to save her world from destruction.

Dive into magical worlds of Aarkalia, uncover its secrets and stop the ancient God awakening ritual.

games.name: Alchi
games.summary: Alchi is a roguelike deckbuilder built around a unique card-mixing system. Slay monsters, unlock distinct characters, and craft outrageously powerful combos by manipulating and mutating your deck!

games.name: Alien Siege: Earth
games.summary: Top-down arcade space shooter with retro pixel-art style. Fight waves of alien invaders across world landmarks, buy upgrades between battles, collect power ups, participate in events & missions, defeat epic bosses, and more.

games.name: Calculator - Desktop Mate Widgets Kagamine Len DLC
Calculator - Desktop Mate Widgets Kagamine Rin DLC
Calculator - Desktop Mate Widgets Megurine Luka DLC
Copter Dude
games.summary: Challenging arcade action game designed for players who enjoy difficult levels. You control a dude with a tiny helicopter, armed with a grappling hook. Dodge deadly traps and hostile enemies, and master challenging obstacle-filled stages where every crash is fatal. Expect a serious challenge.

games.name: Cylindrika
games.summary: Fast paced, free flowing, geometry based 3D arcade style movement shooter. Dash, jump, and slide around to traverse a unique world shape. Manipulate physics to your advantage. Positioning and speed are key. Deterministic enemies require deliberate combat decisions.

games.name: Escape War
games.summary: You are the last person to evacuate a city that is being bombed. Survive and escape.

games.name: Frost-Buried Truth
games.summary: 《Epidemic Prevention:Secret Agency》 is a hardcore first-person stealth survival horror based on brutal true events. Trapped as a test subject in the Epidemic Prevention and Water Purification Department, you must evade relentless pursuit. Hide in the shadows, hold your breath, and escape alive!

games.name: How Many Calories Are In A Muffin?
Lamp Clicker
games.summary: Lamp Clicker is a simple and addictive incremental / idle clicker game where your goal is to build your own… lamp empire.

games.name: Limbot
games.summary:
Welcome to Limbot, the ultimate physics-based city stomping experience where up to 4 players must attempt to pilot a person dressed as a giant cardboard robot! 

Embrace the chaos in a paper-craft metropolis designed to be crushed, smashed, and destroyed!

Intuitive controls make moving limbs simple and accessible to players of all ages and abilities. All you need to do is figure out how to work together... good luck with that! Oh, one more thing, if the robot trips, it's definitely your teammate’s fault!

games.name: Old Coin Pusher Gaiden
games.summary: A new evolution of Old Coin Pusher Friends: a coin‑pusher RPG where you train your samurai, prepare Action Spheres, and explore deep caves filled with enemies, treasures, and events. Shoot Coins to earn rewards. Up to four players can battle The formidable in Raid mode.

games.name: Path of Idle: Old Gods Rising
Pets Survivors
games.summary: Pets Survivors is a survival roguelike where you battle hordes of monsters and fight to stay alive until time runs out. Choose your pet, pick your favorite weapon, upgrade your abilities, and see how long you can survive!

games.name: Pro Jank Footy
games.summary:
Pro Jank Footy is an absurd and over-the-top arcade sports game.

Score a goal? Your opponent picks a game-changing power-up.

Hinder your opponents, increase your footy abilities with powers that give your team strong legs, or turn the gameplay completely on its head by transforming everyone into footballs - the choice is yours!

Outplay, out-kick, and out-jank your mates in local multiplayer. Or, if you’re shy, conquer single-player season mode.

games.name: S.O.L School Of Labyrinth
games.summary: A dungeon crawl RPG set in an otherworldly realm beneath an old school building. Explore again and again, restore your base, and find your way back to everyday life.

games.name: Sky Scramble
games.summary: Local multiplayer air combat across three eras of aviation history. Fight gravity and your friends. Bail out, parachute down, pull out your pistol, and make it personal. Up to 4 players.

games.name: Sort Them Ducks
games.summary: Sort Them Ducks is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 4,000 unique rubber ducks onto the correct shelves. Enjoy the satisfying process of turning a messy duck store into a perfectly organized collection at your own pace.

games.name: Theme Song EP - THEIR SECRET HUMS
Vaulted Valor
games.summary:
Trapped in an underground vault designed to protect humanity, you discover that survival comes at a cost. 

In Vaulted Valor, a narrative-driven post-apocalyptic RPG, every choice matters as you navigate a world of intrigue, sabotage, and hidden agendas. 

Will you unite the vault’s inhabitants to confront its dark truths, or will the fractures within tear it apart?

games.name: 30 Days On Ship: Castaway – The First Days
Anime Fitness - Summer Sweat
games.summary:
Train with pro anime trainers, push your limits, and get stronger with every session! Choose your trainer, level, and routine — then jump into 30 minutes of intense and rewarding full-body w

Turn fitness into a fun, motivating, and interactive experience.

Choose your personal trainer, select your level, and begin your custom fitness journey through structured workouts that keep you challenged and inspired.

Each session combines 7 different exercises, performed for 1 minute 30 seconds with short 30-second breaks — repeated twice for a full 28-minute workout plus warm-up. With over 100 exercises, there are endless variations to keep every session fresh.

Build your personal training schedule across weeks or months, earn rewards for staying consistent, and watch your strength and endurance grow. Each trainer brings unique energy, voice, and encouragement to help you stay motivated.

Vibrant visuals, dynamic environments, and pumping music transform every workout into a fitness adventure. Whether you’re just starting out or chasing peak performance.

This game will help you to stay active, healthy, and motivated long-term.

games.name: BlazBlue Entropy Effect X
games.summary:
A *roguelite action game* set in the BLAZBLUE universe, featuring striking 2D visuals, stylish, fast-paced combat, and precise, responsive controls.
Command a line-up of unique characters from the renowned BLAZBLUE franchise and dive into an unparalleled action experience.

[Story]
At a mysterious domain, known as “the Lab”,a group of elite researchers race to save a collapsing word; however, despite their efforts to date, Dr. Mercurius, head of the laboratory, still warns the world’s downfall is near.
In a last-ditch effort, the urgent *Research of Possibility* initiative seeks to collect *Shards of Possibility*—a special fragment of the world that could forestall the seemingly inevitable destruction.
These shards lie within the *Sea of Possibility*, a realm between worlds, beyond the bounds of reality.
Our protagonist, *Ace*, is the only being capable of diving into this sea.
Guided by the elite researchers at *the Lab*, Ace descends again and again in pursuit of salvation—until strange visions take hold and his body begins to change.
As Ace continues to dive, countless memories flood his mind, and the truth behind the collapsing world—and the research itself—begins to surface....

games.name: Brutal Bible Bloodbaths - AI Assisted Edition
Cairn - On the Trail: Deep Water
games.summary:
On the Trail is a series of free DLCs for the award winning survival climbing game Cairn. Set out on the ascent of a lifetime with pro-climber Aava: climb anywhere, plan your route carefully, and manage your resources to survive the unforgiving ascent of Mount Kami.

On the Trail brings climbers to new climbing locations and challenges. Find your route freely in the new spots, solve fresh climbing problems and explore iconic places as you follow the trail of a legendary climber.

On the Trail: Deep Water, the first of the series, brings you 3 new climbing spots, and introduces water soloing: you can now climb over water, without the consequences when falling!

games.name: Choppa: Rescue Rivals
games.summary: Take to the skies in Choppa: Rescue Rivals! Pilot daring rescue missions in a Saturday-morning-anime story mode packed with high-stakes action, colorful characters, and a globe-trotting adventure. Save lives, outfly rivals, and become a legendary ace pilot! Choppa: Rescue Rivals is a modern-but-retro reimagining of the arcade-style action games made famous by 1980s classics like Choplifter, with a touch of Nintendo mixed in. Like many, we share a deep nostalgia for the vibrant world of the ‘80s and ‘90s media: Arcade games, toys, cartoons and anime that defined our childhoods. Driven by this passion, we set out to create a game that brings those cherished memories to life. A Nostalgic "Saturday Morning Anime" Storyline Step into the cockpit with Rick, a legendary rescue chopper pilot coaxed out of retirement for one last, crucial mission on a disaster-ravaged oil rig. With his rescue pilot license freshly reinstated, Rick is thrust into an unexpected scuffle with Burdock, his former wingman turned adversary, uncovering a sinister plot led by the malevolent A.C.R corporation. As the stakes soar higher, Rick and his comrades from the Thunderbolt Rescue Foundation must outwit and outmaneuver their foes to thwart Burdock's dark ambitions. Dynamic Globetrotting Gameplay Choppa: Rescue Rivals offers a unique blend of chaotic gameplay, compelling storytelling, and cooperative rivalry. Prepare for an unforgettable ride to the skies where luck, strategy and skill will determine the true heroes. Gather your team and don't forget: It's time to GET TO THE CHOPPA!

games.name: CloverPit
games.summary: A rogue-lite slot machine nightmare. Gamble for your life in a never-ending debt simulator!

games.name: Colorizing: Pleasure
games.summary:
Coloring by numbers game for relaxation

This coloring book is a guarantee of good mood.
In it you can find all kinds of pictures for every taste.
Coloring by numbers with Colorizing is a calming and easy activity for people of all ages.
This drawing game is suitable for children and adults, everyone can enjoy pixel coloring.
You will definitely love coloring with this beautiful coloring book!

games.name: Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns
games.summary:
In the 1980s, Defender of the Crown helped define a new kind of cinematic strategy game. Now it returns, rebuilt for modern platforms and remastered with an entirely new way to play.

Conquer territories, raise armies, storm castles, and shift the balance of power. It's the Defender of the Crown you remember - just sharper, cleaner, and built for today.

games.name: Duskfade
games.summary:
Shatter the shackles of time as you jump, swing, and slash through a fantastic world in this love letter to classic 3D action platformers. Zirian, accompanied by his mechanical Cuckoo, must save his sister from a mysterious Clock Tower that has plunged the land into eternal night.

Explore stunning realms shaped by the Master Clockmakers, each filled with mystery, magic, breathtaking vistas, and endearing characters. Navigate ethereal forests, underwater realms, sunlit dunes and cloudy heights - the world of Duskfade is alive and teems with secrets for you to uncover.

Master a seamless blend of dynamic platforming and fast-paced combat. Jump, dash, grapple, and glide your way through thrilling challenges that rekindle the magic of classic action platformer favourites.

games.name: Find the Sneaky Chameleon
games.summary:
Can your memory spot the trick?

Think you can remember what blended into the scene?

It feels easy while the picture is on screen, but once it is covered, that tiny detail can get surprisingly slippery.

This is a quick image-memory quiz with a sneaky chameleon vibe. Study the illustration, keep the small details in your head, then choose the answer from four options.

・Look closely at the image while it is shown
・When part of it is covered, read the question
・Use your memory to pick one of four answers
・After a correct answer, check the original image

Right or wrong, each round trains careful observation and short-term memory in a light, pick-up-and-play way.

Supports button and touch controls.

games.name: Future Knight
games.summary:
Experience the ultimate LCD-style action on Nintendo Switch™!

Future Knight is a 2D action shoot ’em up that blends the nostalgia of LCD handheld games with the brutality of modern combat. Imagine your old portable gaming device brought to life, complete with a bizarre story, frantic battles, and a unique visual style inspired by classic electronic games.

8 HOURS UNTIL THE END OF THE WORLD

It’s May 23, 1993. The Lady of the Past, leader of the pyramid cult “Present,” has just washed her underwear and, in the process, erased the minds of all humanity. Only you—a robot built over the course of 30 years from the remains of a 1990s soap opera actor—can stop her. But you’re not alone. You have Two More, an inexplicably powerful, sentient benign tumor living inside you.

Your mission is to travel back in time exactly eight hours before the apocalypse. Each level (Biome) represents one hour in the Lady’s schedule before she wipes out everyone’s memories. You’ll need to sabotage her entire day—from a stroll through the park to a meal at an all-you-can-eat buffet. The clock is ticking, Future Knight. Can you save the future before it becomes the past?

games.name: Grayland Remastered
games.summary:
A noir story of a tiny bird fighting to bring colour back to a dying world.

Caught between the endless war of Humans and Aliens, you are a small bird struggling to survive in the ruined, radioactive lands of Grayland. What was once a peaceful home has become a scorched, lifeless battlefield.

Fly through breathtaking hand-painted environments, dodge enemy drones, cleanse toxic hotspots, and confront colossal bosses in your journey to save your loved ones. Discover the haunting mystery behind the fall of this world — and fight to restore hope where none remains.

Key Features
* 16 handcrafted and challenging levels
* Atmospheric noir art style with a deeply emotional story
* Varied and intense boss encounters
* Beautiful, immersive soundtrack

Remastered Edition Enhancements
* 4K resolution with enhanced visuals and refined animations
* Redesigned controls optimized for the DualSense™ controller
* Rebalanced difficulty system for smoother, more rewarding progression

Even the smallest being can change the fate of a world. Be the one who brings life back to Grayland.

games.name: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam
games.summary:
Enter the explosive conflict of the Vietnam War and fight your way through some of the fiercest clashes in modern history. 

Join the battle raging across an extreme landscape of vast mountain gorges and thick jungle, where the North Vietnamese Armies clash with the military strength of the US Armed Forces. Build tunnels, fly helicopters, drive patrol boats, use historically accurate weapons and work with your team to achieve victory.

Take the battle to the enemy across 6 large-scale maps that authentically recreate real world locations and dramatic terrain. Play as either the North Vietnamese Army or US Armed Forces and choose from one of 19 specialised roles within a 50-strong team made up of multiple squads. Join or lead infantry, recon, armour, mortar squads and helicopter units, using communication and teamwork with your fellow players to identify objectives and ruthlessly exploit your opponent’s weaknesses.

Follow the chain of command and work together as a team to meet your objectives and achieve victory.

games.name: Idle Immortal
games.summary:
Build a Chinese fantasy sect, recruit disciples, and forge the ultimate squad for ascension! Are you ready to walk the path to immortality as a true Sect Master?

+ Idle Gameplay: Enjoy a relaxing idle experience designed to help you unwind. Even while you are away, your sect keeps battling, growing stronger, and moving closer to ascension. 

+ Squad Building: Recruit from 16 playable characters. Each character has unique talents, classes, and skills. Bring in the disciples you need and freely build your own squad. 

+ Character Growth: Each character can choose one of six different cultivation paths. They can also practice different cultivation techniques to gain unique bonuses. Even characters of the same class can grow into completely different builds. 

+ Explore the World: Journey across the land, discover other sects and factions, and advance the story. Gather resources for personal cultivation and sect development. Encounter random events and uncover unexpected treasures. 

+ Sect Management: While exploring the world, you will also manage your own sect. Earn reputation and sect resources to upgrade and expand your home base. Build different sect facilities to continuously produce useful items. A powerful sect will help you go further on the path to immortality.

games.name: It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator Demo
Lost to Time
games.summary: Lost to Time is a time-pause focused 2D action platforming metroidvania game, with a carefully crafted world to explore in an non-traditional fantasy RPG fashion. In order to overcome insurmountable odds, Chrona must manipulate the flow of time in order to gain advantages over opponents.

games.name: Madden NFL 27
games.summary: The next chapter of the legendary football game is coming soon with Madden NFL 27. Experience all-new gameplay, mode updates, and more as you step onto the gridiron and play for NFL glory.

games.name: Museum Girls Fleet Maneuvers: The Dockhand
Nightmare Shift
games.summary: Take on night shifts at a remote motel, handle unsettling guests, and navigate eerie events. Experience Emma’s unnerving apartment life, feel the unease of being watched, and question what’s real as the line between reality and nightmare blurs.

games.name: Onryou Senki
games.summary:
Use your deductive powers to battle spirits in this unique Miyaji City horror adventure!

Originally released in 1988 by Studio WING, this classic adventure game puts you in the shoes of Hiroyuki Kitahara, a young man who awakens to supernatural powers after a chilling encounter. Set in the eerie Miyaji City—a place plagued by a string of bizarre incidents—you must harness your deductive skills to battle vengeful spirits and uncover the truth.

The game utilizes a classic command-based system, making it accessible and intuitive for all players. Its distinct graphics and haunting sound design work in tandem to pull you deep into a world where the living and the dead collide.

While detective mysteries dominated the adventure scene of the era, this title stood out for its innovative fusion of investigation and exorcism. We invite you to experience the dark visual style and iconic soundscapes that made this unique horror adventure a standout title.

games.name: Open The Gate: Just A Little
Panzer Knights: Commander's Edition
games.summary:
Take command of a German panzer platoon and lead your forces through the chaos of World War II in this gripping tank simulation that blends hardcore strategy with anime-inspired visuals. Engage in explosive third-person combat across the battlefields of Europe, where every round counts. Load specialized ammunition, target enemy weak points, and call in tactical support as you adapt to the ever-changing situation on the front line.

Between missions, assemble an elite tank crew by handpicking recruits with unique skills, and deploy a formidable arsenal of meticulously detailed tanks, each with their own characteristics, strengths, and vulnerabilities.

In a conflict where victory is achieved through cunning, adaptability, and precision, do you have what it takes to emerge triumphant?

games.name: Pixel Lens: Real-time Pixel Art Filter
Plungeez
games.summary:
Explore the underground labyrinth of a historic city’s sewers and uncover secrets in an interconnected world.

Plungeez is an exploration-focused puzzle-adventure that puts your mind to the test. Dive deep into a complex underground sewer system in the historic city of Salvador, Brazil, where progress isn’t measured by brute force, but by perception and logic.

Run, push, activate, and explore. Like a Metroidvania, Plungeez’s map is vast and full of hidden connections that require you to go back and forth to solve the central mysteries. With no combat distractions, you can fully focus on the mechanics of each puzzle and the unique atmosphere of this pixel-art world.

games.name: Primary School - English Grade 1 & 2
games.summary:
Complete Grade 1 & 2 English – fun, guided & smart learning quizzes for kids.

Primary School – English Grade 1 & 2 is a complete, curriculum-based English learning adventure designed especially for young learners.

With 7 adorable animated characters, children explore every important topic from Grade 1 and Grade 2 in a fun, structured, and supportive environment.

Each grade includes:
- Around 10 main topics
- 5–10 subtopics per topic
- Step-by-step explanations for every concept
- Guided multiple-choice quizzes
- Optional final year test
- A detailed learning overview for parents

From capitalization and punctuation to grammar, reading comprehension, and vocabulary — the game covers the full curriculum in a playful, accessible way.

games.name: Shinkansen Card Pull Simulator
games.summary:
This game features 50 unique cards showcasing real photographs of Tokaido and Sanyo Shinkansen bullet trains. 

From the cutting-edge N700S to the classic 0 Series that started it all, and even the legendary Doctor Yellow Type 923 T4 - retired in 2025 - build your ultimate Shinkansen collection.

games.name: SimRail - The Railway Simulator: Łódź North Region
Skatesterre
games.summary:
Skatesterre is a fast-paced arcade skateboarding game inspired by the golden era of classic skate titles.

Link together huge combos, land stylish tricks, and shred through levels designed for speed, flow, and creativity.

Ride as Sterre Meijer a.k.a. Surfsterre, Dutch skateboarder and rising figure in the global skate scene, and carve your way through streets, parks, and urban playgrounds packed with rails, ramps, and hidden lines.

Complete missions, chase high scores, and unlock new fashion pieces as you progress - building your own unique skate style along the way.

games.name: Spear Of The Sky Supporter Edition
The Derailed: Devour the Harvest Demo
The Pirate Keko
games.summary:
Get ready for an adventure full of discovery, strategy, and tropical charm. In The Pirate Keko, you take control of a charismatic pirate monkey in search of hidden treasures across mysterious islands, where each level is much more than it first appears.

Here, every level is a clever puzzle divided into two connected parts. First, you must explore the environment, manipulate blocks, activate mechanisms, and find the Treasure Map. But that is only the beginning. Once you collect it, the game reveals a new layer of the challenge: the Treasure Chest appears, and the same scenario must be reinterpreted using everything you have already changed.

Color-coded platforms, pressure buttons, breakable crates, hazards, and enemies create dynamic situations that demand planning and creativity. Every action matters, as what you do in the first half directly impacts the solution of the second.

With a fixed camera that lets you see the entire scene, the experience is clear, strategic, and focused on spatial reasoning. You are not just moving forward, you are transforming the environment step by step until you find the perfect path.

With short, clever, and highly satisfying challenges, The Pirate Keko delivers that unique “now I get it” feeling with every completed level.

Observe, experiment, adapt, and discover. Because here, finding the map is only half of the adventure.

games.name: Tiny Paw Academy - Numbers Fun
games.summary:
Fun Learning for Preschoolers

Tiny Paws Academy: Numbers Fun is the perfect learning game for preschoolers! Featuring 15 charming mini games set in a world of adorable forest and farm animals, this is early education at its most playful.
Using your controller, children navigate a friendly on-screen cursor to count animals, compare groups, train their memory, recognise numbers and dice, and discover which animal is biggest or fastest — all brought to life with beautiful animations and delightful sounds.
Perfect to share on the couch or let your little one explore independently!

WHAT YOUR CHILD WILL LEARN
• Counting and number recognition
• Comparing groups and sizes
• Memory and observation skills
• Logical ordering and sequencing
• Species recognition and categorisation

15 MINI GAMES INCLUDE
• Did you see this animal?
• Which group is bigger?
• Find the fastest / biggest animal
• Count all animals and species
• Numbers and dice in the correct order
• Animals coming out of a magical hat
• Memory and much more!

games.name: Tower Dominion
games.summary:
Your empire faces relentless invasions from the savage Artronids, threatening its very existence. As Commander, you are the last line of defense against the deadly enemy onslaught.

Survival depends on constant innovation and adaptation. Every alien wave is a unique combination of Artronids that will test your ability to adapt.

Are you ready to employ innovative tactics, build impregnable defenses and hold the line? Commander, your troops await your orders!

games.name: Train Sim World® 6: Schnellfahrstrecke Nürnberg - Ingolstadt Route Add-On
Tyrant's Realm
games.summary: Tyrant's Realm is a roguelite action-adventure inspired by classic PS1 visuals. Explore procedurally generated dark fantasy worlds, battling through dangers that evolve with each run. Death is not the end, as the night is still young.

games.name: Vengeance of Mr. Peppermint
games.summary:
A 2D side-scrolling phantasmagoria featuring extreme violence and Korean thriller vibes.

The player takes control of a character obsessed with revenge. This is a killing game and the player can feel it and get the maximum emotional outburst.

Cruelty, paradoxicality, and unexpected plot twists allow us to build a hardcore slasher for lovers of bloody fatalities and precisely controlled combos.

Utilizing an environment for killing - hooks in a slaughterhouse, meat cutting conveyors, ovens.

games.name: Wild Blue Skies
games.summary:
Wild Blue Skies reimagines the classic on-rail adventures of the '90s. Join Bowie Stray and the Blue Bombers as they soar through the skies on a mission to save the world in this action-packed, nostalgic journey! 

Wild Blue Skies is an exciting and modern take on the classic on-rail adventures of the '90s.

Soar over oceans, desert ridges, and perilous caves, battling waves of enemies and pushing back Grimclaw’s forces. With the help of allies, you’ll fight to restore peace while experiencing the thrill of classic arcade flight-combat!

Easy-to-learn controls make Wild Blue Skies accessible for newcomers and genre veterans alike, while the game’s stunning visuals immerse you in a hand-crafted, anime-style universe. With its compelling gameplay loop, branching paths, and thrilling missions, every flight is an adventure! 

Key Features: 

* Experience all the classic on-rails shooter action with new and modernized controls
* Discover a rich and colorful world with stunning vistas at every turn
* Fly through an action-packed campaign alongside a stalwart squad of allies 
* Take on exciting boss battles and dogfights against a mysterious rival squad
* Discover secret paths and missions on your quest to take down the evil Baron 
* Become an ace pilot and master every mission through a simple and challenging score system

games.name: Eerie Night - Escape from the Funfair - Collector's Edition
Grave Seasons
games.summary:
Build your farm, fish and mine, and explore the unknowns of a strange, ancient town all while romancing the secretive local townsfolk. Just make sure you stop the supernatural murders before it’s too late… 

What happens when you blend an unnatural serial killer with a idyllic, isolated mountain town? 

You escaped jail and managed to make it to Ashenridge, but at what cost? Build your farm, fish and mine, and explore the unknowns of a strange, ancient town all while romancing the secretive local townsfolk. Just make sure you stop the supernatural murders before it’s too late… in GRAVE SEASONS, an all-new murder mystery farming sim RPG!

games.name: I Was a Failed Day Trader Who Lost Everything, But After Being Reincarnated in Another World, My Textbook Technical Analysis Actually Works and Now I'm the Richest Man in the Kingdom!?
Kiss And Cry：我的女友脑子有问题
Lootbound
games.summary: Lootbound is a tactical roguelite with turn-based combat, loot management and D&D elements set in a dark fantasy world. Fight dangerous enemies, collect epic loot, recruit allies and lead them on a path of adventure.

games.name: Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor
games.summary:
Sicily – Winter, 1905. In the months since his initiation, Enzo Favara has proven himself a reliable soldier of the Torrisi crime family. Now the Don entrusts him and Cesare with a delicate assignment: assist Ennio Salieri, a man of honor recently released from prison and intent on reclaiming what is his.

At Salieri's side, Enzo is drawn deeper into the volatile underworld of the Valle Dorata, where loyalty is tested, debts are settled, and every move carries weight.

Continue Enzo's story across two new chapters, featuring fresh environments, weapons, vehicles, and Charms. In new DLC content for Free Ride mode, team up with Salieri to earn big by taking on a new set of exclusive jobs and extreme challenges, and discover new collectibles and hidden locations as you explore.

games.name: Static Dread: The Submarine - Digital Art Collection
Static Dread: The Submarine - Original Soundtrack
Static Dread: The Submarine - Supporter Pack
Typing With Ghostie - A Happy Little Ghost
Typing With Ghostie - Ducky Ducky Ducky

I Want to Play the Villain! Demo
Rag Doll - Fun Fighting with Physics
The Lantern of the Laughless Saint
The World Well: Blood of Caro
ARC Raiders - The Tick Hunter Set
Backyard Baseball
games.summary: The timeless classic is leveling up with all-new game modes, new ways to play, brand-new features and more. It’s the game you love, reimagined for a whole new era. Get ready for Backyard Baseball like you've never experienced it before.

games.name: Darkest Dungeon: The Fire's Edge
games.summary:
“...we have each of us in the dustiest cellars of our minds a counter at which we strive to repay the debts of the past with the debased currency of the present.” - Gene Wolfe

Two more wayward souls wander the Old Road. The Duelist and Runaway, debuted in Darkest Dungeon II, bring their unique abilities to bear against horrors that lurk beneath the manor.
Patterned in burns, draped in tatters and wielding a crude poker, the vagrant Runaway favours fire and stealth when pressed to fight.
By contrast, the Duelist stands severe, her ornate capelet conspicuously pierced above the breast. No challenger has yet to hold quarter against her bitter edge.


Features:

    Two new hero classes: the Duelist and the Runaway
    Set the dungeon alight with Runaway’s new combat mechanic: Burn!
    New Trinket Mechanics such as Trigger Uses, Quest Charges and Progressive Trinkets
    3 new Hamlet Districts: Academie Duello, Craftworks, and Archaeological Base Camp


The Runaway is a position-flexible damage dealer utilizing a unique Burn damage type with high synergy for teams that like to utilize Stuns and Pull/Knockback/Shuffle effects.

The Duelist is a complex damage dealer that dances between the party’s ranks, able to freely maintain Riposte while alternating between her two combat stances, Defensive and Aggressive. Proper planning of the Duelist’s future turns is key to mastering her playstyle and maximizing her potential!

Fans of both games will delight in this re-visioning of these two new iconic heroes for Darkest Dungeon.

games.name: Starsand Island
games.summary:
This Killer Deck has won tournaments and has crushed hundreds of opponents. You have to check this Killer Deck out for yourself, and see if you can build a deck just like it. Then, check and test it with the people you duel with, Improve your Skills, Learn the Game and become a Master Duelist!


-A Killer Deck contains, strong four-star monsters
-A way to summon tribute monsters without having to tribute
-A way to draw extra cards
-40 cards in your deck ,and no more
-Cards the let you search your deck for other cards
-Creatures that summon other creatures when their destroyed
-Cards that can wipe out your opponent's monsters, traps, spells and fusion cards.

With the correct combination of monster, traps, spells and fusion cards you can make your own Killer Deck unbeatable.

games.name: TFC2: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of The Bronze Age
The Sinking City 2
games.summary:
The Sinking City 2 is a terrifying Lovecraftian journey, powered by Unreal Engine 5. Experience a heart-pounding survival horror as you explore the flooded city of Arkham and fight eldritch monsters beyond human comprehension. 

* Immerse yourself in a distinct atmosphere of cosmic horror and twisted designs drawn from the dark wellsprings of HP Lovecraft's macabre imagination. 
* Explore and survive the city of Arkham, a sprawling labyrinth of flooded alleys and decrepit mansions where eldritch horrors lurk just out of sight. 
* Use an arsenal of weapons to fight off Deep Ones, Mi-gos, occult zealots, and other iconic monsters from the source material as well as new and unique creatures that expand the Cthulhu Mythos. 
* Experience the classic survival horror formula at its finest, complete with inventory management, optional puzzles, and backtracking to newly unlocked areas and hidden treasures. 
* Use environmental storytelling and scattered clues to solve side mysteries that unlock new outcomes and gameplay bonuses.  
* Thanks to Unreal Engine 5, The Sinking City 2 delivers next-gen visuals with Lumen global illumination, photorealistic Nanite geometry, life-like Metahuman-powered characters, and much more.

games.name: 宠物街金鱼姬 Pet Street Story
Archerio
games.summary:
A fast-paced 3D archery roguelike. Clear deadly rooms, stack wild powers, defeat bosses.

Archerio is a run-based action roguelike where every room is a new test of aim, movement, and quick decisions. Dash, strafe, and thread your shots through chaotic battles as you fight for “one more room.”

Each run lets you craft a new build with powerful abilities and upgrades — stack elemental arrows, boost crits, summon helpers, or trade safety for damage. Learn enemy patterns, adapt on the fly, and bring down relentless bosses waiting at the end of each push.

games.name: Nioh 3: Hell Rising
games.summary: A new shadow of intrigue takes over future Edo in Hell Rising. Our protagonist and appointed shogun, Takechiyo, journeys through time and is led to Edo in the future by an unknown yokai he met in his dreams. There, following the death of the future Takechiyo, the era of peace has ended, and Edo has been retaken by the Crucible. With the cooperation of a one-eyed swordsman, Yagyu Jubei, and a Spanish envoy, Rodrigo, Takechiyo faces yet another plot revolving around Spirit Stones and an enemy with a strong resentment towards the shogunate.

games.name: No Case Should Remain Unsolved
games.summary:
February 5, 2012. A little girl named Seowon is reported missing from a playground. Police launch an investigation and question witnesses and suspects, but Seowon's case is never solved.

Twelve years after Senior Inspector Jeon Gyeong's retirement, she is visited by a young police officer: a woman who pleads with her to reexamine Seowon's case.

But with each uncovered memory, only one thing becomes clear: everyone in Seowon's vicinity was lying.

#No_Case_Should_Remain_Unsolved is a detective game where players uncover and piece together memory fragments to solve a long-forgotten case. Follow former police detective Jeon Gyeong as she acquires clues and testimony relating to the case of a missing girl.

games.name: The Walks We Used To Take
Train Plus Japan Drive Western Japan Trains! Rapid Service Edition
games.summary: Drive real JR-West trains! An authentic railway driving game — Approved by West Japan Railway Company. Three fictional lines, every section drivable in both directions. A series-first scoring system and card-deck strategy turn precise driving into high scores. Over 40 hours of content.

games.name: Ascent DX
games.summary: Crashed on a desolate but mysterious planet you find yourself eye to eye with an ancient civilisation. Explore the planet, find powerful upgrades, and fulfill your destiny.

games.name: Can Your Otaku Cabinet Grow a Beautiful Girl?
Contraband: Edge of the Fold Soundtrack
DayZ
games.summary: The post-soviet country of Chernarus is struck by an unknown virus, turning the majority population into frenzied infected. Fighting over resources has bred a hostile mentality among survivors, driving what’s left of humanity to collapse. You are one of the few immune to the virus - how far will you go to survive?

games.name: Dino Hex Trap
games.summary:
Prepare for a prehistoric battle where intelligence matters more than brute force. In Dino Hex Trap, every trap can completely change the course of the invasion, and every decision transforms the battlefield into a massive strategic puzzle filled with action and creativity.

Forget fixed towers and predictable strategies. Here, you control traps placed across a dynamic hexagonal field where direction, spacing, and positioning make all the difference. Rotate, reposition, and combine traps to turn seemingly safe routes into true corridors of Jurassic destruction.

Waves of dinosaur-inspired creatures keep advancing, and it is up to you to stop them before they reach your base. But resources are limited, so every choice matters: expand your defense with new traps or reorganize the ones you already have? Improvisation is part of survival.

As the campaign progresses, new trap types unlock increasingly creative possibilities. Some levels already begin with fixed structures spread throughout the map, completely changing the way you think about strategy and forcing you to constantly adapt.

With 30 levels spread across morning, afternoon, and night biomes, Dino Hex Trap combines planning, resource management, and spatial awareness in fast, smart, and deeply satisfying challenges.

With stylish visuals, engaging battles, and that perfect feeling of “now my strategy is brilliant,” Dino Hex Trap is an irresistible experience for players who love strategic defense, meaningful decisions, and defeating hordes in the most creative ways possible.

Watch the paths, prepare your traps, and prove that even dinosaurs can fall into the perfect plan.

games.name: Driving Is Hard
games.summary:
Challenge yourself in Driving Is Hard!

Drive a bathtub on wheels through steep, unforgiving terrain where every mistake costs you progress. Master tough physics-based gameplay, sharpen your patience, and uncover Jeff’s journey of self-doubt, family struggles, and emotional growth as he finds strength, self-acceptance, and hope for a brighter future.

games.name: Dungeon Antiqua 2
games.summary: Relive the golden age of dungeon RPGs with Dungeon Antiqua 2! A retro 2D dungeon crawler bursting with SNES nostalgia. Hack, slash, and survive relentless side-view encounters! With 10 jobs and endless skill combos, forge the ultimate party and conquer the depths—if you dare!

games.name: Gallipoli
games.summary:
What began on mainland Europe, was never likely to end there... Prepare for relentless WW1 beach landings and desert warfare across the Middle Eastern Front in Gallipoli!

Faced with the deadlocked trenches of the Western Front, the Triple Entente looked for new pathways to victory. What was thought to be a quick expeditionary campaign to remove a German ally from the war, ended up in a disastrous four-year campaign: the Ottoman Empire wasn’t going down without a fight.

Gallipoli marks the fourth entry in the WW1 Game Series, further broadening its authentic and realistic FPS combat experience to give you the deepest dive into the Middle Eastern Front of World War 1 yet.

games.name: Grim Trials
games.summary: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials. Explore the (after)life of the Academy – a training ground for aspiring Grim Reapers. Befriend fellow Reapers, learn from your mentors, and uncover the secrets of your life and love before your death.

games.name: Ground Zero Hero
games.summary: Kill mutants. Absorb their remains. Mutate into something stronger every run. Stack insane power combos and survive overwhelming hordes in this fast, chaotic, highly replayable action roguelite bullet hell.

games.name: Mexican Ninja
games.summary: Become the Mexican Ninja and fight to take back Nuevo Tokyo, where Narcos and Yakuzas have fused into the ruthless Narkuzas. Master slick combos, unleash outrageous Mexican Jutsus and craft deadly builds in this fast, chaotic 2.5D roguelike beat ’em up.

games.name: Mortal Shell II
games.summary: Their Flesh Is Your Weapon. Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.

games.name: OVER REQUIEMZ
games.summary:
You have wandered into Oz, a faraway kingdom ruled by four witches and the king, after being caught up in a terrifying tornado. 

But you are not welcome. Sentenced to death upon arrival, you are ordered to investigate mysterious ruins along with four murderers on death row and a secretive supervisor of the condemned. 

Your only choice is to escape the death sentence and discover a way home.

games.name: Puppergeist
games.summary:
Doggie Underworld: A Rhythmic Journey

Play as Claire, a witch who journeys into the mysterious Doggie Underworld with one simple goal: Finding her lost Pup!

As you travel through Doggie Underworld, you'll encounter countless souls, each with a story to tell. Share moments with them, play together, and listen to their heartfelt tales. Use your sense of rhythm to lift their spirits and ease their troubles, bringing you one beat closer to reuniting with your own lost Pup.

The Heart of the Game

As a visual novel with rhythm mechanics, the story moves forward as you succeed in rhythm challenges. Alongside her new demon friend, Lunne, Claire learns to deepen her connection with doggie spirits, uncovering stories of friendship, love, and loss.  Every rhythm challenge is unique, along with remixes and bonus features.

games.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl - Cost of Hope
games.summary:
The fragile peace between Duty and Freedom stands on the brink of collapse. The heartlands of the Zone, forbidden for decades, now call to stalkers. New dangers - or perhaps wonders - begin to emerge.

Prepare to embark on a new expedition into the Zone in this massive nonlinear expansion, where dozens of hours of gameplay, unforgettable stories, and twisted characters await. A new chapter of the S.T.A.L.K.E.R. saga begins - shaped by your choices and actions in a journey you must survive, endure, and explore.

A chance to learn the Сost of Hope is upon us, stalkers.

games.name: The Witch's Bakery
games.summary:
The Witch's Bakery is a cozy Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris. She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal emotions through magic!

The story progresses through the days as you earn experience, money, and fame, meet new friends and heal their heart.

For some people, their emotion is locked away so strongly than Lunne needs to go inside their heart to help them. She enters their "Heart Palace", a magical space where emotions and thoughts take shape. Lunne needs to guide the personified Emotion back to the heart.

Inside the Heart Palace, Lunne discovers the person's deepest struggles and finds the key ingredient she needs to make a bread that will heal them!

games.name: Wobbly Life
games.summary: Wobbly Life is a lively open world physics based sandbox. Play with your friends in Online and local co-op, discover a variety of minigames and objectives to earn cash to spend in the world!

games.name: Yet Another Zombie Survivors
games.summary:
The Horde is coming but you're ready to fight it! 

Assemble your team and decide upon their enhancements to find the most efficient synergies against thousands of the undead. Survive. Then evolve. Then break all the limits in this deceivingly simple but addictive reverse bullet hell.

games.name: Colorbound
games.summary: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue. As Anku, an Aymara boy with a unique gift, you’ll harness the power of color to shape the environment itself, uncovering hidden paths to navigate challenging and complex puzzles.

games.name: Mega City Force
games.summary: The crime is out of control, the streets are not clean. There are criminals and psychopaths everywhere, ready to cut anyone's throat. A corrupt megacorporation squeezes the life out of the citizens, seeking to establish control all over the city. Only the incorruptible police officers of Mega City Police Department stand fast before the crime wave that consumed the city and threatens to overwhelm society. Choose your cop and dive into a deadly battle against the criminals and brutal bosses to unleash the beast of justice in the darkest corners of the city.

games.name: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2
games.summary:
This is a fight for survival. Xenomorphs swarm in overwhelming numbers. Every room could be your last. 

Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 drops up to four players into the boots of Colonial Marines deployed to the most hostile corners of the Aliens universe. This is not a rescue mission – it’s a fight for survival. Xenomorphs stalk the corridors, ambush from the shadows, and swarm in overwhelming numbers. Every room could be your last. Coordinate with your fireteam, leverage each class’s unique abilities, and adapt on the fly as encounters escalate from tense standoffs to all-out war. With deeper squad mechanics, smarter enemies, and a fully customizable Specialist class, AFE2 delivers the definitive co-op Aliens experience. 

4-Player Co-Op Squad Combat
Expanding from three to four players, AFE2 introduces deeper team-based mechanics that reward coordination and strategic class composition. New and improved classes each bring distinct playstyles and tactical abilities to the fight, making every squad combination feel different. 

Xenomorphs That Overwhelm You
The iconic xenomorphs are more ferocious than ever before. AFE2's massive variety of new xenomorphs will force players to stay mobile, maintain situational awareness, and use every tool at their disposal. From stun batons for up close melee action in those most desperate moments, to pyro and electric ammo to whittle down the unrelenting xenomorph front before they overrun you and your squad, the battle can shift from calculated tension to desperate last stand in seconds. 

The Specialist Class -- Play Your Way
Beyond expanded weapon and gear customization, AFE2 introduces the Specialist -- a fully customizable class that lets players mix and match major and minor abilities from every available class. Build a loadout tailored to your exact playstyle and fill whatever role your squad needs. 

Horde Mode -- Survive the Swarm
AFE2 launches with multiple dedicated Horde maps that push squads to their limits. Battle through escalating waves of xenomorphs and other deadly enemies, earning increasingly valuable rewards as you survive deeper into the onslaught. This is where teamwork and skill are tested at their absolute peak.

games.name: Apidya' Special
games.summary:
The legendary 1992 Amiga shoot ’em up Apidya is making its long-awaited comeback. 

Developed by the original team, together with a devoted Apidya super-fan-turned-developer, Apidya’ Special is based on a previously abandoned 1990s console port, combining original assets with all-new pixel art, additional authentic sound effects, and remixed music. Legendary composer Chris Hülsbeck contributes an exclusive, completely rearranged soundtrack which has never been released.

Players can experience Apidya’ Special in true widescreen with new parallax effects or switch to the original Amiga 4:3 mode that looks, plays, and sounds exactly like 1992. Optional CRT effects with simulated shadow mask, scan lines, and phosphor bloom recreate the classic display feel.

games.name: Blood Dungeon
games.summary:
From the creators of Nidhogg comes a game about 2D platforming survival. You'll have to parkour your way around treacherous dungeons to kite monsters while gathering blood and powerups. 

Survive a run, take the bones you’ve earned to the Bone Shop, and get stronger. 

Complete quests to unlock upgrades, arenas, skins, and more.

games.name: Once Human
games.summary:
Once Human is a multiplayer open-world survival game set in a strange, post-apocalyptic future. Unite with friends to fight monstrous enemies, uncover secret plots, compete for resources, and build your own territory. Once, you were merely human. Now, you have the power to remake the world. 

The apocalypse changed everything. Human, animal, plant... all are infested by an alien creature -- Stardust. As a Meta-Human, you can survive the contamination and use the power of Stardust. Play alone or join others to fight, build and explore. When the world is in chaos, you are our last hope. 

Battle numerous enemies that are once human, and challenge bosses from another dimension to gain powerful items and ease Stardust pollution. You are not only fighting for yourself, but also fighting for the survivors.

Use Territory Core to build a house of your own. You can keep a practical style, jamming everything needed in a small room; or you can design a townhouse with a patio, kitchen, garage… The best part is, you can relocate your territory any time you want!

Delve into the truth of Stardust, find out where it came from, and what it wants. In the journey of seeking truth, you may feel alone, but you are never alone. There are several factions in the world, some can be violent and hostile, others might be friendly and helpful. Explore human settlements to learn their stories or exterminate bosses without leaving a name for survivors to praise, the choices are yours.

games.name: 28 Days Train Wreck Survivor
games.summary:
Stranded after a brutal train crash, your survival begins now.

You wake amidst twisted metal and shattered carriages, trapped between steep cliffs and a vast lake. With only your wits and determination, you must explore, gather, and fight to stay alive for 28 days — until rescue arrives.

Every decision counts. Every resource matters. Will you endure?

EXPLORE THE WRECKAGE
Search every train car for supplies, tools, and hidden loot. Some wagons are locked or contain only fragments of the gear you need, forcing you to combine parts and improvise to survive.

MASTER RESOURCE MANAGEMENT
Hunt, fish, forage mushrooms and berries, and collect wood. Keep fires burning, craft essential tools, and make every piece of salvaged material count.

CRAFT & SURVIVE
Build makeshift shelters, repair damaged gear, and create survival equipment from scavenged parts. Creativity and resourcefulness are the keys to lasting 28 days.

FACE THE WILD
The wilderness is dangerous — giant lizards and other predators lurk everywhere. Stay alert, defend yourself, and never underestimate the wildlife.

PLAN FOR THE 28-DAY CHALLENGE
Balance risk and reward. Explore further or stay safe. Every day brings hunger, cold, and new dangers — only careful planning and bold action will see you through.

CROSS-SAVE & CROSS-BUY
Start your struggle on PlayStation®4 and continue seamlessly on PlayStation®5. Your progress and your tools move with you — your fight for survival never has to stop.

Do you have the skill, patience, and grit to survive all 28 days?

games.name: Aggelos 2
games.summary:
Jump into an action-packed 2D retro Metroidvania adventure where reactive combat, smart exploration and powerful polarising abilities collide.

Aggelos 2 is a full evolution of the original, now thrusting the visuals into the 16-bit era. Its transformational twist takes the gameplay to another level, as the world now exists in two overlapping realms: Light and Darkness.

You are an Aggelos - the highest rank among the angels - as the gods face imminent defeat at the hands of the Army of Darkness, you are sent on an epic journey by Balro through Lumen, the domain of the supreme god of light. With Lumen under siege, you must battle through the chaos in both the Light and Dark worlds layered over one another. Both filled with challenging enemies, twisting paths, and thought-provoking puzzles. Shifting between realms is key to your survival and progress.

games.name: Brigandine Abyss
games.summary:
Once upon a time, the world was saved by the Brigandine. This arcane armor, forged by the great sorcerer Lunadea, brought an end to the ambitions of the Abyssloa Empire.

200 years have since passed, and the continent’s current greatest superpower, the Kingdom of Solginat, has grown into a disquieting presence. In response, the rulers of various nations, spearheaded by the queen of Mysteine - a realm that carries on Lunadea’s will - gather together to issue a formal denunciation...

games.name: Ghetto Zombies: Graffiti Squad
games.summary:
Ghetto Zombies is an intense pixel art action shooter where you take control of different heroes from an elite squad to face hordes of zombies and eccentric creatures.

Armed to the teeth with quirky weapons - like ketchup pistols, bubble gum launchers, and water guns - you'll explore a chaotic city, showcase your art with graffiti, defeat challenging bosses, and hunt for the cure to the epidemic!

games.name: Golftacular!
games.summary: Mini-golf turned upside down! Abuse wild items on a variety of challenging golf tours. Shoot, fly, explode, and whatever else you can to get in the hole! It’s golf… barely.

games.name: Infection Free Zone
games.summary: Choose any real region from the world. Choose your base of operations, then rebuild and readapt the buildings around you to create a self-sustaining settlement. Take charge of a group of survivors from your city. And when the night falls - Defend the zone from the infected!

games.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Baekje Military Museum
Lou's Lagoon
games.summary:
Launch from the sea and take to the skies! Lou's Lagoon is a cosy open world adventure where you make friends and uncover secrets across a gorgeous archipelago.

Collect, harvest, fish, craft and trade various goods, then deliver them safely to the individual islands in your trusty seaplane. Customise and strengthen your plane over time, overcoming storms, pirates, and magic in order to reach new islanders. Forge new connections and service your community.

Secrets lurk in the corners of every island. While completing deliveries, you'll also unearth treasures and find clues about your wacky uncle Lou.

games.name: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots - Master Collection Version
games.summary:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected. Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” Immerse yourself in the Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you can infiltrate and elude your enemies to complete missions. The game takes place five years after the Big Shell incident in METAL GEAR SOLID 2: Sons of Liberty, in a world where war has become a business. To stop Liquid Ocelot's uprising, Solid Snake throws himself into his final battle.

The battle against Liquid and the Patriots draws to a close, and the mysteries woven throughout the series are now revealed!

【STORY】

THE TRANSFORMATION OF WAR INTO BUSINESS.

In an era where PMCs (private military companies) have risen to the top, war has become a business and the driving force behind the world economy.

Controlling the top five PMCs from behind the scenes is Liquid Ocelot, who fanning the flames of war even further, plans an insurrection with the goal of creating a world where warriors can lead fulfilling lives—a goal shared by none other than Big Boss.

Under the theme of “Sense” watch as the final battle of the man with Big Boss’s genes, Solid Snake, unfolds.

----------

The Screenplay Book containing in-game text from Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots and the Master Book detailing the story and characters are also included within the game.

Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” Immerse yourself in the Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you can infiltrate and elude your enemies to complete missions.

Also, as purchase bonuses for the collection edition, it includes METAL GEAR Ghost Babel—the series first title for handheld consoles, released in 2000—and Metal Gear Solid: Digital Soundtrack Vol.2, featuring numerous iconic tracks that enhanced Snake's missions, ranging from BGM used in the games to vocal songs.

[Game List]
Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots
Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version)
Metal Gear: Ghost Babel
*Versions for other regions of Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots can be downloaded separately from the store.
*Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version) supports online play for up to 6 players.

games.name: Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker - Master Collection Version
games.summary:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.
Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you avoid combat and complete missions while hiding.

The game take place 10 years after METAL GEAR SOLID 3: Snake Eater.
Amidst the swirling conspiracies behind the East-West Cold War, Snake confronts them while leading a private military force.
This is the story of how one soldier, “Snake”, becomes “Big Boss”.

games.name: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
games.summary:
Set 15 years before A Plague Tale: Requiem, play as Sophia, a fierce young plunderer, on the run but determined to uncover the secrets of her past. Dive into an original story blending combat, myth and fate with a brand new take in the universe of A Plague Tale.

Sophia’s journey leads to the Minotaur' Island, where she faces deadly trials, navigates treacherous trails, solves puzzles, all while fighting and staying one step ahead of the army chasing her. But the true challenge awaits, as the terrifying creature hidden behind the myth will soon resonate with her...

Every step is a risk. Every pause, a potential end. You can’t stop, only hide, outsmart, and push forward. Can you survive each trial and every step or will you join those who never came back?

games.name: Star Wars Zero Company
games.summary: Recruit an unconventional team of operatives and deploy them on missions unlike any other in the galaxy far, far away in Star Wars Zero Company!

games.name: The Immortal John Triptych
games.summary:
Immortal John is dying. A holy war has ended in chaos. Sin itself demands reckoning. Three interconnected tales unfold across a world built from Renaissance paintings and Classical music, where the ridiculous and the profound collide. 

Help locals with their daily tasks, only to find the Devil lurking in the shadows. Chase a tyrant across kingdoms while assisting inept magicians and negotiating with God Almighty. Navigate sin, death, judgement, heaven and hell, all topped with a cherry of gleeful flippancy. 

From quiet countryside kindness spiraling into madness, to holy vengeance wrapped in absurdity, to cosmic philosophy delivered with a wink and a nudge, The Immortal John Triptych proves that the most intelligent thing you can do is embrace the utterly ridiculous.

games.name: Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters
games.summary:
The next episode of Tsubasa’s riveting adventure is here! Enjoy the thrill of spectacular soccer actions with 110 playable characters and new sensational super moves. 

CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WOLRD FIGHTERS invites fans to follow their journey to victory by creating their own character and joining Tsubasa on his quest. Players will forge new friendships, fight new rivals, and bring the trophy back home.

Action on the field has been significantly enhanced for this new release. New super moves increase the intensity of every part of the game, allowing players to dominate the field when they pass, dribble, tackle or block with their own special techniques.

Even blocking goal shots becomes more tactical with a new system that pits goalkeeper against shooter, letting both players experience and counter jaw dropping super shots and blocks from characters of the original series.

games.name: Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition
games.summary:
With over 28 million copies sold worldwide, ELDEN RING is an award-winning, action RPG set in an authentic dark fantasy world. Explore treacherous dungeons and face epic boss battles. 

ELDEN RING Tarnished Edition on Nintendo Switch 2 includes the base game, SHADOW OF THE ERDTREE, and new weapons, armour Torrent skins, and more.

games.name: Toaplan Arcade Garage: Flying Fire Shark
games.summary: The Shark series, created by legendary Japanese studio Toaplan, is a landmark shoot ’em up series. Flying Shark (1987), which was well received for its simple rules and exquisitely tuned difficulty level, had a tremendous impact on vertical scrolling shoot ’em up games. The sequel Fire Shark (1989), with its screen-filling weaponry, set arcades ablaze with its destructive carnage!

games.name: Onimusha: Dawn of Dreams
games.summary: Onimusha: Dawn of Dreams begins approximately 15 years following the annihilation of the infamous Japanese warlord Oda Nobunaga at Honno Temple. Another dark shadow now looms over Japan as Nobunaga's successor, Hideyoshi Toyotomi, has decided to align himself with the evil Genma forces. Assume the role of Soki, a young warrior who possesses incredible power, along with several other cohorts to try and thwart Hideyoshi's pursuit for power. [Capcom]

games.name: Puzzledorf
games.summary:
An elegant, block-pushing puzzle game with clean design, exploring the question, "What makes a good puzzle?" Set across multiple, beautiful worlds in a bright, colourful pixel art style. Includes colour blind options.

This game follows the philosophy: A good puzzle is something that looks simple, is easy to understand at a glance, but the solution surprises you. It teaches anyone how to play, helps grow your puzzle solving skills and slowly challenges you.

The puzzle is simple - push the correct coloured block onto the correct coloured cross. Red blocks on red crosses, green blocks on green crosses.

Can you win?

games.name: Serious Sam: Shatterverse
games.summary: Serious Sam: Shatterverse is a co-op roguelite FPS for 1 - 5 players. Blast through shifting universes, stack wild boons, bend the rules with run modifiers, and hunt Mental's deadliest forces. Fall fast. Come back louder.

games.name: Crimson Moon
games.summary:
Ken, a high school student, is suddenly swallowed into another world, and he decides to take desperate action to rescue his younger sister.

In this strange world illuminated by the red moon, a terrible tragedy unfolds.... A tense search and a battle to the death await you.

Isekai survival horror RPG. defeat the enemy or escape, your decision will make the difference between life and death. A horror RPG with large character dots and a death-defying storyline.

games.name: Nidhogg + Nidhogg 2
games.summary:
NIDHOGG: Nidhogg is the epic award-winning fencing tug-of-war, full of graceful acrobatics and clumsy stabs. IRL yelling and excitement may occur, in this ultimate two-player showdown of fast-paced fencing and melee attacks.

NIDHOGG 2: The wurm has returned and it must feed! Shed your garments and paint the walls with the flesh of your enemies, for only one can be worthy of sacrifice. The rules are simple. Reach the other side and kill anyone that stands in your way. Deftly parry and rend their throats, riddle their bowels with arrows, or squish their brains between your toes. The wurm cares not for chivalry.

games.name: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
games.summary:
Will is back to business in this Action-RPG with roguelike elements!

With no coin to your name, you and the other townsfolk find yourselves stranded in the distant village of Tresna. Now, it’s up to you to get back on your feet and turn your humble shop into the beating heart of the village’s wealth. 

Explore dangerous dungeons, gather relics, sell them, and reinvest in your friends’ establishments. Unlock new weapons, armor, shop decorations, and - more importantly - restore hope that things can one day turn around.

games.name: Super Woden: Rally Edge
games.summary:
The spin-off of the acclaimed Super Woden saga, blending classic arcade essence with great depth and a genuine love for car culture.

With a unique personality, Rally Edge takes you back to an era where fun goes beyond realism.

games.name: AereA
games.summary: AereA is an Action RPG in which music is both your best friend and your worst enemy. As a disciple of the Great Maestro Guido you have to unravel the mysteries of Aezir. Find out what happened to the world and return the nine primordial instruments to restore balance and bring peace to the world.

games.name: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game
games.summary:
Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game is a fast-paced 1v1 fighter where you battle as your favorite characters from the Avatar franchise. Featuring hand-drawn 2D animation true to the series’ roots, proprietary rollback netcode, and full cross-play for smooth, competitive gameplay.

Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game is a fighter rooted in the spirit of elemental mastery. Designed for both newcomers and veterans, it channels the energy of classic fighting games while breaking new ground in movement, style, and combat expression. Built with a focus on fluidity, responsiveness, and online integrity, the game invites players to discover what it truly means to fight with purpose.

Hand-drawn in 2D, it is crafted to preserve the style and expressive animation of the original series.

games.name: BioEden
games.summary:
Welcome to BioEden, a cozy management game where you will build a self-sustaining network of structures, all working in harmony to bring extinct animals back to life. As a Keeper, you have been entrusted by the Cosmic Collective to bring life back to a planet quietly waiting to be healed. 

Upon your arrival, search for debris sites scattered across the land, they are the foundation of your journey. Recycle them into resources, and use those to build the base of your network: a solar energy system to generate electricity, and a water system to distribute it across all your buildings. Connect them together, weave a network across the land, and manage the supply and demand for every structure you create.

But plan with care. Each addition to your planet consumes resources, draws on energy, and nudges pollution upward. Find the balance between creation, exploration, and restraint, to accomplish the very mission that brought you here.

games.name: Fight School Simulator
games.summary: Are you ready to become a legendary martial arts master? Build your own school, train your students, and battle rival dojos to become the strongest. Join tournaments, raise your grasshoppers, and most importantly, collect tuition from your students!

games.name: Marsupilami 2 - Salsa Palombia
games.summary: A strange melody has swept across Palombia… and suddenly every animal starts dancing wildly, throwing the jungle into total chaos! Behind this rhythmic madness lurks the Mummy Queen, back from the Underworld with her crew to deliver a cursed concert with devastating effects. To restore peace to the jungle, take control of the three young Marsus, each with their own signature ability. Twister shoots through the air with a turbo glide, Hope leaps forward with an energetic spinning jump, and Punch bounces with powerful force to knock aside anything in his path! Switch instantly from one Marsu to another to unleash their powers and chain together stylish moves. And for even more fun, share the adventure with a friend thanks to local co‑op mode! From the Jungle to the City, from Snowy Mountains to the mysterious Underworld…explore four enchanting worlds packed with surprises, challenges, and unique gameplay mechanics. Beyond the main adventure, take on the Flow Mode, a speed-focused challenge where you must complete a series of trials without dying to prove your skills! And for even more fun, challenge your friends in competitive dojos.

games.name: Orbitals
games.summary:
Launch into Orbitals, an intergalactic 2-player co-op adventure set in a classic retro anime universe!
 
Team up as explorers Maki and Omura to brave the perils of space and save their home from the dangers of a supernatural cosmic storm.
 
As you navigate uncharted areas, close collaboration is vital - remember, you can only save your home by working together!

games.name: Pardon My French Toast
games.summary: Pardon My French Toast is a 3D platformer starring a slice of toast who covers himself in sweet spreads to get fun abilities.

games.name: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed
games.summary:
SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed is a fast-paced competitive platformer and a sequel to one of the most beloved indie games of the 2010s. Pick a character of your choice from a vibrant cast of eccentric superheroes, both returning and new, and face off against your rivals in frenetic running races for up to 8 players per lobby, locally or online.

The original multiplayer gameplay formula of SpeedRunners is timeless, unofficially dubbed as the ‘Mario Kart of 2D platformers’. With the sequel, our goal is to carefully bring this unique ‘SpeedRunners feel’ into the new era without compromising on the depth and fluidity of the movement system while still keeping it easy to grasp. On top of that, King of Speed introduces vibrant high-definition graphics and improved netcode.

games.name: Star Racer
games.summary:
